data: Which language pair has the highest initial BLEU score?

The question asks which language pair has the highest initial BLEU score. From the caption, we know that the figure shows ELBO and BLEU scores for two datasets: ASPEC Ja-En and WMT'14 En-De. The lines represent the scores over iterative steps, and the legend indicates the color coding for each dataset.

Looking at the initial values (the first point on the x-axis labeled 'initial'), the red line (representing Ja-En) is above the blue line (representing En-De). This suggests that the Ja-En dataset has a higher initial BLEU score than the En-De dataset. Therefore, the language pair with the highest initial BLEU score is Ja-En.
